propositions: Multiple divergent bundles for one S3 ref cause git-remote-s3's cmd_push to reject all writes and clone to fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed', rendering the store unclonable
Upstream's Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive-only and discards non-chosen heads, losing append-only events unique to those heads

An autonomous healer must losslessly merge all divergent bundle heads via iterated 2-parent merges (never octopus, following sync._union_merge semantics) and write the merged tip before deleting any original bundles to maintain crash-safety

The healer acquires the helper's per-ref S3 lock, re-enumerates bundles under that lock (TOCTOU guard), fetches all divergent heads locally, merges them into a single lossless tip, puts the merged bundle as a new immutable object, then deletes the originals
Concurrent repair processes coordinate via the helper's conditional-put lock (IfNoneMatch/60s TTL), with non-winners backing off to converge on the single healed bundle on their next push retry

The healer runs under rebar's write_lock (outer: S3 per-ref lock, inner: local write_lock) with no merge=union driver, reusing rebar's existing lossless multi-parent merge and .gitattributes merge=ours for derived cache files
